sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the inspector
sections.what: Brings in React helpers for memory, caching and state, plus the data types for records and components.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: Fact
sections.title: Single source record display
sections.what: Shows one source record: its subject, value, unit, truth and review state, file, page, region, file fingerprint, optional authority and normalised value details, limitations and notes.
sections.why: Likely reason: every number is shown with where it came from and how sure the project is.
sections.watch_out: Optional claim lines appear only when the data has them, so a record without them looks shorter rather than broken.

sections.name: BoundFacts
sections.title: Bound facts and the main inspector
sections.what: Lists the source records tied to one part, 20 at a time, with missing IDs shown as missing. The main inspector then shows the asset's source decisions, collapsed, and one block per part, 40 at a time, each with its size, provenance, limitations and linked records.
sections.why: Likely reason: large assemblies would be slow and hard to read if every part and record were printed at once.
sections.watch_out: Source decisions are matched by name against the asset key, so renaming an asset key removes them without any error.

summary: Shows, for each shared assembly part, its size, placement, shape and material origin, and the source records behind it.
purpose: Lets a reviewer see where each value came from and how certain the project is about it.
why: Likely reason: the page says these solids are display detail, so every value must carry its status and source.
how: Selects the source decisions that match the asset name, then draws one collapsible block per part. Each block lists provenance, limitations and linked source records, and shows more on request in batches.
inputs: A component with its parts and asset key, plus the full list of source records.
outputs: A section on screen. No data is changed or saved.
risks: Matching is by name, so a renamed asset silently loses its source decisions. Lists are cut to batches, so some records need a click to see.
debug: If a part shows no source, check that its source IDs exist in the evidence list and that the subject name matches the asset key. Compare with the expected text in PartInspector.test.tsx.
